# Machine-level rules: floorplans of places, and programs scheduled on them

These judge a machine built from gadgets (`qccd/gadget`, docs/GADGETS.md), one level above a device. Use them when the design under review is a floorplan or a scheduled logical program, not a single device. Every op of a place is still a device programme judged by the device rules (`rules.md`), and H1 asks the roads between places to obey R1-R23 too.

## `floorplan`: A floorplan's rules

Places, junctions, roads and wires, judged before any program is scheduled: what any floorplan must respect, whoever drew it.

### F1: A road or a wire joins two doors that agree (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F1
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:12`

> Both ends carry the same thing -- ions of the same role, width and code, or bits of the same signal -- and they face opposite ways.

```
(for all r in roads, a in ends(r), b in ends(r) where a != b:
   medium(a) = medium(b)
   and (role(a) = role(b) or role(a) = "any" or role(b) = "any")
   and (role(a) != "data" or role(b) != "data" or
        (width(a) = width(b) and (code(a) = none or code(b) = none or code(a) = code(b))))
   and (dir(a) != dir(b) or dir(a) = "inout"))
and (for all w in wires, a in ends(w), b in ends(w) where a != b:
   medium(a) = medium(b)
   and (signal(a) = signal(b) or signal(a) = "any" or signal(b) = "any")
   and (dir(a) != dir(b) or dir(a) = "inout"))
```

### F2: Every door of a place is on one road, and a junction arm on one at most (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F2
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:25`

> A place's ions come and go through its doors, so each door is on exactly one road; a junction's arm is on at most one.

```
(for all d in doors where medium(d) = "ions" and family(owner(d)) != "road":
   count(r in roads where d in ends(r)) = 1)
and (for all d in doors where family(owner(d)) = "road":
   count(r in roads where d in ends(r)) <= 1)
```

### F3: Footprints do not overlap (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F3
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:32`

> No two places (or junctions) stand on the same piece of the chip.

```
for all p, q in placed where p != q: not overlaps(p, q)
```

### F4: Roads meet only at junctions (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F4
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:36`

> A road runs through no place it does not serve, and two roads never cross or touch: where roads meet, there is a junction, and they meet it through its arms.

```
(for all r in roads, p in placed where p not in owners(r): not passes_through(r, p))
and (for all r1, r2 in roads where r1 != r2: not crosses(r1, r2))
```

### F5: A bundle can wait in front of every door

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F5
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:41`

> A road that ends at a place's door holds at least a whole bundle, so a bundle that arrives while the place is busy can wait on it.

```
for all r in roads, d in ends(r) where family(owner(d)) != "road":
  length(r) >= width(d)
```

### F6: Every out door reaches every in door

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F6
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:46`

> A bundle leaving any place can be brought to any other place, along roads and through junctions.

```
for all a, b in doors where medium(a) = "ions" and medium(b) = "ions" and dir(a) = "out" and dir(b) = "in" and family(owner(a)) != "road" and family(owner(b)) != "road" and owner(a) != owner(b):
  reachable(a, b)
```

### F7: Every classical door of a place is wired to the control floor

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F7
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:51`

> Every place that measures, reports an outcome or can be told to run has each of those doors wired to the decoder or the classical memory.

```
for all d in doors where medium(d) = "bits" and not classical(owner(d)):
  for some w in wires where d in ends(w):
    for some e in ends(w) where e != d: classical(owner(e))
```

### F8: The decoder's corrections reach the classical memory

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F8
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:57`

> The decoder's frame door is wired to a classical memory, which is where corrections are kept.

```
for all d in doors where family(owner(d)) = "decoder" and signal(d) = "frame":
  for some w in wires where d in ends(w):
    for some e in ends(w) where e != d: family(owner(e)) = "archive"
```

### F9: Every place stands in a region of its kind

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#F9
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/floorplan.rules:63`

> Zones in memory; preparation, syndrome extraction, transversal gates, lattice surgery and readout in compute; factories and injection in factory; depots in supply; the decoder and the classical memory in control; junctions in traffic.

```
for all p in placed: region(p) = home_region(family(p))
```

## `machine`: The machine's rules

A floorplan of verified places joined by roads and wires, and a logical program scheduled on it: what every gadget-level schedule must respect, whatever runs in parallel.

### G1: Ports on a road agree, and every bundle arrives in the order its place takes it in (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G1
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:17`

> A road or a wire joins two doors that carry the same thing (ions of the same role, width and code, or bits of the same signal) in opposite directions; a door that is not a free-for-all is on one road at most; and every bundle an op takes in arrives, in exactly the order the op's verified program takes it.

```
(for all r in roads, a in ends(r), b in ends(r) where a != b:
   medium(a) = medium(b)
   and (role(a) = role(b) or role(a) = "any" or role(b) = "any")
   and (role(a) != "data" or role(b) != "data" or
        (width(a) = width(b) and (code(a) = none or code(b) = none or code(a) = code(b))))
   and (dir(a) != dir(b) or dir(a) = "inout"))
and (for all w in wires, a in ends(w), b in ends(w) where a != b:
   medium(a) = medium(b)
   and (signal(a) = signal(b) or signal(a) = "any" or signal(b) = "any")
   and (dir(a) != dir(b) or dir(a) = "inout"))
and (for all d in doors where role(d) != "any":
   count(r in roads where d in ends(r)) <= 1)
and (for all k in intakes:
   delivered_by(k) != none and delivered(k) = expected(k))
```

### G2: Every ion leaves only from where it is, and ends where it should (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G2
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:36`

> Follow every ion through every handoff: it is loaded only if it did not exist, it leaves only the place it is in, it arrives only from the road it is on; every resident ion ends at home, and every loaded ion ends dumped at a depot or in a block still alive.

```
(for all h in handoffs: location(ion(h), before(h)) = origin(h))
and (for all i in residents: location(i, final()) = home(i))
and (for all i in loaded where i not in living: location(i, final()) in depots)
```

### G3: No place holds more ions than its capacity (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G3
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:42`

> At every instant, counting an ion in a place from the moment it arrives until the moment it leaves, no place other than a depot holds more ions than it was built for, or gives away more than it has.

```
for all p in places, t in instants where family(p) != "depot":
  occupancy(p, t) <= capacity(p) and occupancy(p, t) >= 0
```

### G4: A road holds at most its sites, and carries one way at a time (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G4
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:47`

> No road ever holds more ions than it has sites, and no two bundles travel it in opposite directions at once.

```
(for all r in roads, t in instants: occupancy(r, t) <= capacity(r))
and (for all c1, c2 in carries where road(c1) = road(c2) and simultaneous(c1, c2):
   origin(c1) = origin(c2))
```

### G5: A place runs one op at a time (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G5
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:53`

> Two ops of the same place, junctions and the classical places included, never overlap.

```
for all a, b in events where a != b and place(a) = place(b) and duration(a) > 0 and duration(b) > 0:
  not simultaneous(a, b)
```

### G6: No ion gets hotter than the ion-loss limit

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G6
- Sources: arXiv:1210.3655
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:58`

> Neither inside a place's op, nor crossing one of its doors, nor on its way between places does an ion's motional energy pass the limit beyond which it is likely to be lost. Its n-bar is followed through every op, road and junction: a road and a junction pass add what their replay charges, and an op is replayed from the n-bar its ions arrive at, so a bundle that crossed twenty junctions is as hot as it is.

```
for all e in events:
  exit_heat(e) <= ion_loss_limit() and peak_heat(e) <= ion_loss_limit()
```

### G7: Every instruction is carried out, and each block's in program order (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G7
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:66`

> No instruction is refused or left without an event, and an instruction that acts on a block's ions starts only after the previous instruction on that block has finished with them.

```
(for all i in instructions: not refused(i) and realised(i))
and (for all i, j in instructions where next_on_block(i, j): begins(j) >= finishes(i))
```

### G8: No block waits longer than its coherence budget without syndrome extraction

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G8
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:71`

> Between ops that extract its syndromes, a block may wait or travel, but not for longer than the memory's coherence lets it.

```
for all b in blocks: longest_gap(b) <= coherence_budget
```

### G9: Every op used is verified (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G9
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:75`

> Every op the schedule runs at a place is verified as hardware and as logic (or certified); an op of the classical half is modeled, its latency a stated number.

```
for all e in events:
  (status(e) = "verified" or status(e) = "certified" or (classical(e) and status(e) = "modeled"))
  and not logic_failed(e)
```

### G10: Every classical bit is used after it exists

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G10
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:83`

> A message crosses a wire the floorplan has, between that wire's doors, in that wire's latency; it leaves no earlier than the op that measured its bits began and, unless it is a syndrome a decode sent out of its readout buffer, no later than that op ended; something at its destination uses it after it arrives; and no line of the classical memory names a measurement that has not begun.

```
when count(m in messages) > 0 or count(w in wires) > 0:
(for all m in messages:
   wire(m) != none and connects(wire(m), m) and approx(duration(m), latency(wire(m))))
and (for all m in messages where measured_by(m) != none: start(m) >= start(measured_by(m)))
and (for all m in messages where measured_by(m) != none and not held(m) and not classical(origin(m)):
   start(m) <= end(measured_by(m)))
and (for all m in messages:
   for some e in events where place(e) = destination(m) and instruction(e) = instruction(m):
     start(e) >= end(m))
and (for all f in frame_rows, e in named(f): start(e) <= at(f))
and (for all o in outcomes, e in named(o): start(e) <= at(o))
```

### G11: The decoder is called, and keeps up

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G11
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:97`

> Every syndrome the machine measures is sent to the decoder by a decode instruction, no earlier than it was measured; every decoding job starts after its syndrome arrives and before the next one does (or the decoder falls behind); a classically controlled op starts only once its guard is at its door; and nothing reads an outcome before the decoder has corrected it.

```
when decoder_present() or count(e in guarded) > 0:
(for all j in decode_jobs:
   syndrome_of(j) != none and start(j) >= end(syndrome_of(j))
   and (next_syndrome(j) = none or start(j) <= end(next_syndrome(j))))
and (for all e in guarded:
   start(e) >= ready(e) and (for some m in decisions(e): end(m) <= start(e)))
and (for all w in windows:
   decoded(w) and (for some m in sends(w): start(m) >= measured(w))
   and (for all m in sends(w): start(m) >= measured(w)))
and (for all e in guarded, w in reads(e): ready(e) >= written(w))
and (for all f in frame_rows, w in reads(f): at(f) >= written(w))
```

### G12: Every bundle that travels is taken in at the far end (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G12
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:113`

> No ion is left on a road: every carry ends with the ops at its destination taking each of its ions in exactly once, in the order it travels -- one op for a whole bundle (a place's, a depot taking used ions back), or a junction's lone passes, one ion at a time, as the road delivers them.

```
for all c in carries: taken(c) = order(c)
```

### G13: A road carries one bundle at a time (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G13
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:117`

> A road is leased to one bundle from the moment its first ion enters until its last is taken off the far end; two bundles never share a road at once, so neither can block or overtake the other, whatever runs in parallel.

```
for all c1, c2 in carries where c1 != c2 and road(c1) = road(c2): not simultaneous(c1, c2)
```

### G14: A road holds the ions on it

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#G14
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:121`

> At no moment are more of a bundle's ions on a road's sites than it has. By the road's own compiled program, an ion that has arrived waits on the far door's stub, which has room for the bundle, until it is taken in, so a short street between junctions holds only the few ions crossing it at once. Without the program, an ion counts as on the road from when it leaves until it is taken in.

```
for all c in carries: crowd(c) <= length(road(c))
```

### H1: The hardware between gadgets obeys the basic rules (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#H1
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:128`

> A gadget is a box with doors, but the chip is one: what carries ions between the boxes is driven by DACs and electrodes like what moves them inside one. Every carry, compiled with its whole bundle onto its road's own device -- one class a cycle, a shift rigid, a blocked ion holding by its switch -- passes R1-R23; it delivers every ion before the far side takes it; and a door's stub is driven by one side at a time, the road never loading or delivering while the op there moves an ion on or off it.

```
for all c in carries: road_ok(c)
```

### H2: Devices that share a plane play one waveform at a time (core)

- Website: https://qccd.academy/rules/#H2
- Defined at: `qccd/ruleset/library/machine.rules:132`

> A floorplan may say that devices share one plane of DACs, or one laser, instead of driving their own. Then they are one set of channels: at no instant do two of them play different cycles -- each op's TSIR at its times, each road's compiled program -- unless it is the very same cycle (class, direction, start and end), played once for both. Members take turns; a trip over two roads of one plane waits between them.

```
plane_conflicts() = 0
```

## The words machine-level rules use

| Word | Is | Meaning | Read off a programme | Read off a timed schedule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `at(x)` | an instant | When frame row x was written, or outcome x recorded. | n/a | n/a |
| `before(h)` | an instant | The instant just before handoff h. | n/a | n/a |
| `begins(i)` | an instant | When the first op on ions of instruction i starts. | n/a | n/a |
| `blocks` | a set of blocks | The logical blocks of the program: each a bundle of ions holding one encoded qubit. | n/a | n/a |
| `carries` | a set of activities | Every bundle carried along a road: from the first ion leaving one door to the last taken in at the other end. | n/a | n/a |
| `classical(x)` | true or false | Whether place x (or the place activity x happens at) holds no ions: the decoder and the classical memory, whose ops are modeled. | n/a | n/a |
| `code(d)` | a name | The code whose data ions door d carries, or none if it does not say. | n/a | n/a |
| `connects(w, m)` | true or false | Whether wire w runs between the two doors message m goes from and to. | n/a | n/a |
| `crosses(r1, r2)` | true or false | Whether the routes of roads r1 and r2 meet anywhere: two roads may only meet at a junction, through its arms. | n/a | n/a |
| `crowd(c)` | ions | The most ions of carry c on its road's sites at one moment, as the road's compiled program has them (an ion waiting at a door is on its stub); without one, each is on it from when it leaves until it is taken in at the far end. | n/a | n/a |
| `decisions(e)` | a set of messages | The decision messages that tell classically controlled op e's place whether to run it. | n/a | n/a |
| `decode_jobs` | a set of events | Every decoding job the decoder runs. | n/a | n/a |
| `decoded(w)` | true or false | Whether some `decode` instruction sent window w to the decoder. | n/a | n/a |
| `decoder_present()` | true or false | Whether the floorplan has a decoder. | n/a | n/a |
| `delivered(k)` | a list of ions | The ions intake k takes off its carry, each when the carry says it was taken, in the order the carry brings them: the whole bundle for a place's op, one ion for a junction's lone pass. | n/a | n/a |
| `delivered_by(k)` | a carry | The carry that brings intake k's bundle to its door (arriving when the op's own replay takes its first ion in), or none. | n/a | n/a |
| `depots` | a set of places | The ion depots: where fresh ions are loaded and used ones are dumped. | n/a | n/a |
| `destination(x)` | a place | Where carry or message x ends: the place it reaches. | n/a | n/a |
| `dir(d)` | a name | Which way door d is crossed: "in", "out" or "inout". | n/a | n/a |
| `doors` | a set of doors | Every port of every placed gadget, junction arms included. | n/a | n/a |
| `events` | a set of activities | Every op the machine runs at a place: a place's op, a junction passing a bundle, a job at the decoder or the classical memory. | n/a | n/a |
| `exit_heat(e)` | quanta | The hottest a bundle leaves event e's place: the op replayed from the n̄ its ions really arrive at, after every op, road and junction before it (0 if no ion leaves). | n/a | n/a |
| `expected(k)` | a list of ions | The ions intake k's op takes in, in the order its verified program takes them. | n/a | n/a |
| `family(x)` | a name | What place x is (or the place door, or activity, x belongs to): "prep", "se", "operation", "surgery", "readout", "zone", "factory", "injection", "depot", "decoder", "archive", or "road" for a junction. | n/a | n/a |
| `finishes(i)` | an instant | When the last op on ions of instruction i ends. | n/a | n/a |
| `frame_rows` | a set of frame rows | Every line written into the classical memory: an outcome recorded, a frame updated, a guard resolved. | n/a | n/a |
| `guarded` | a set of events | Every classically controlled op: it runs only when a condition on measured outcomes holds. | n/a | n/a |
| `handoffs` | a set of handoffs | Every time an ion changes hands: loaded at a depot, leaving a place onto a road, or arriving from a road into a place. | n/a | n/a |
| `held(m)` | true or false | Whether message m is a syndrome a `decode` instruction sent out of the readout buffer it waited in (the one kind of bits that may leave after the op that measured them). | n/a | n/a |
| `home(i)` | a place | Where resident ion i lives. | n/a | n/a |
| `home_region(f)` | a name | The region a place of family f belongs in: a zone in memory; preparation, syndrome extraction, transversal gates, lattice surgery and readout in compute; factories and injection in factory; depots in supply; the decoder and the classical memory in control; junctions in traffic. | n/a | n/a |
| `instruction(x)` | an instruction | The instruction activity x is part of. | n/a | n/a |
| `instructions` | a set of instructions | The instructions of the logical program. | n/a | n/a |
| `intakes` | a set of intakes | Every bundle an op takes in through one of its doors. | n/a | n/a |
| `ion(h)` | an ion | The ion handoff h moves. | n/a | n/a |
| `ion_loss_limit()` | quanta | The hottest an ion may get before it is likely lost: about 85 uncooled junction round trips (arXiv:1210.3655), at 3 quanta a transit. | n/a | n/a |
| `ion_sites(c)` | a number | How much shuttling carry c is: its ions times the sites of its road. | n/a | n/a |
| `latency(w)` | microseconds | How long a bit takes to cross wire w. | n/a | n/a |
| `length(r)` | a number | How many sites road r has: its route length less one. | n/a | n/a |
| `living` | a set of ions | The ions of the blocks still alive when the program ends (never read out). | n/a | n/a |
| `loaded` | a set of ions | The ions loaded at a depot while the program runs. | n/a | n/a |
| `location(i, t)` | a place or a road | The place or road holding ion i at instant t; none before it is loaded. | n/a | n/a |
| `logic_failed(e)` | true or false | Whether the logic check of the op event e runs failed (its flows or its fault distance). | n/a | n/a |
| `longest_gap(b)` | microseconds | The longest time block b spends, from its birth to its readout (or the end), with none of its ions in an op that extracts syndromes (preparation, a syndrome round, lattice surgery, injection). | n/a | n/a |
| `measured(w)` | an instant | When window w's bits exist: the last measurement of the op that measured them. | n/a | n/a |
| `measured_by(m)` | an event | The op whose measurement made message m's bits, or none. | n/a | n/a |
| `medium(d)` | a name | What crosses door d: "ions" or "bits". | n/a | n/a |
| `messages` | a set of activities | Every burst of bits sent along a wire. | n/a | n/a |
| `named(x)` | a set of events | The events whose measurements frame row or outcome x is a parity of. | n/a | n/a |
| `next_on_block(i, j)` | true or false | Whether j is the next instruction after i, in program order, that acts on the ions of a block i acts on (instructions that move no ion -- a decode, a Pauli kept in software -- are skipped). | n/a | n/a |
| `next_syndrome(j)` | a message | The first syndrome to reach the decoder after the one job j works on, or none. | n/a | n/a |
| `order(c)` | a list of ions | The ions of carry c in the order they travel. | n/a | n/a |
| `origin(x)` | a place | Where carry or message x starts: the place it leaves. | n/a | n/a |
| `outcomes` | a set of outcomes | Every logical measurement result the classical memory records. | n/a | n/a |
| `overlaps(p, q)` | true or false | Whether the footprints of places p and q overlap (touching along an edge is not overlapping). | n/a | n/a |
| `owner(d)` | a place | The place (or junction) door d belongs to. | n/a | n/a |
| `owners(r)` | a set of places | The places (or junctions) whose doors road r ends at. | n/a | n/a |
| `passes_through(r, p)` | true or false | Whether road r's route runs through the inside of place p's footprint. | n/a | n/a |
| `peak_heat(e)` | quanta | The hottest any ion gets inside the op event e runs: the op replayed from the n̄ its ions really arrive at (heat followed across the town). | n/a | n/a |
| `place(x)` | a place | Where activity x happens (an op, a pass, a classical job). | n/a | n/a |
| `placed` | a set of places | Every placed gadget, junctions included. | n/a | n/a |
| `places` | a set of places | Every placed gadget of the machine that is not a junction: the places blocks are brought to, the depots, the decoder and the classical memory. | n/a | n/a |
| `plane_conflicts()` | a number | How many times two devices that share a plane (of DACs, or one laser: the floorplan's `plane`) play different cycles at once -- every op's TSIR at its times, every road's compiled program. 0 when nothing shares a plane. | n/a | n/a |
| `reachable(a, b)` | true or false | Whether a bundle leaving door a can reach door b along roads, crossing junctions (places are endpoints, never thoroughfares). | n/a | n/a |
| `reads(x)` | a set of windows | The decoded windows holding the outcomes classically controlled op x's guard (or guarded frame row x's condition) reads. | n/a | n/a |
| `ready(e)` | an instant | When the guard of classically controlled op e was resolved and at its place's door, as the scheduler says. | n/a | n/a |
| `realised(i)` | true or false | Whether some event of the machine carries out instruction i (a Pauli kept in software is carried out by the classical memory). | n/a | n/a |
| `refused(i)` | true or false | Whether the scheduler refused instruction i (and why is said with it). | n/a | n/a |
| `region(p)` | a name | The region the floorplan puts place p in: "memory", "compute", "factory", "supply", "control", or "traffic" for a junction. | n/a | n/a |
| `residents` | a set of ions | The ions that live in places from the start (ancillas, a surgery seam, a factory's staff). | n/a | n/a |
| `road(c)` | a road | The road carry c travels along. | n/a | n/a |
| `road_ok(c)` | true or false | Whether carry c, compiled with its whole bundle onto its road's own device (one class a cycle, blocked ions holding by their switches), passes the basic rules R1-R23, delivers every ion before the far side takes it, and keeps off each door's stub while the op on that side drives it. | n/a | n/a |
| `roads` | a set of roads | Every conveyor road between two doors: a channel bundles of ions travel along. | n/a | n/a |
| `role(d)` | a name | What the ions crossing door d are for: "data" (a block's data ions), "magic" (a resource state), "fresh", "messenger", or "any". | n/a | n/a |
| `sends(w)` | a set of messages | The syndrome messages that carry window w from the place that measured it to the decoder. | n/a | n/a |
| `signal(d)` | a name | What the bits crossing door d mean: "syndrome", "outcome", "frame", "decision", or "any"; none for a door of ions. | n/a | n/a |
| `status(e)` | a name | The verification status of the op event e runs: "verified", "certified", "modeled" or "failed" (the reporting contract of the place library). | n/a | n/a |
| `syndrome_of(j)` | a message | The syndrome decoding job j works on: the earliest one its own instruction sent that no earlier job has taken. | n/a | n/a |
| `taken(c)` | a list of ions | The ions of carry c as the ops at its far end take them in, each op's share in turn: carry c's own order, if every ion is taken once. | n/a | n/a |
| `traffic()` | a number | How much shuttling the whole execution is: the sum of ion_sites over every carry. | n/a | n/a |
| `wait(c)` | microseconds | How long the last ion of carry c waits at the far end of its road before it is taken in. | n/a | n/a |
| `waits(c)` | true or false | Whether some ion of carry c is taken in at the far end later than it gets there: the bundle waited on road c. | n/a | n/a |
| `width(d)` | a number | How many ions cross door d in one bundle. | n/a | n/a |
| `windows` | a set of windows | Every syndrome window: the check outcomes one op measured, waiting in its place's readout buffer until a `decode` sends them. | n/a | n/a |
| `wire(m)` | a wire | The wire message m crosses, or none if the floorplan has no such wire. | n/a | n/a |
| `wires` | a set of wires | Every classical link: it carries bits from one door to another, never ions. | n/a | n/a |
| `written(w)` | an instant | When the decoder's correction for window w was written into the classical memory; none if it never was. | n/a | n/a |
